beat: Dhika's voluntary kissing-practice offer; two consecutive source-described kisses and visit close

lines.original: As she sat on the sofa.... Chotu decided that he would leave and was about to go and change his dress,.... when Dhika grabbed his arm and pulled him into the sofa next to her...
lines.local: Dhika sofa par baithi toh Chotu jaane ke liye kapde badalne utha. Dhika ne uska haath pakadkar use kheench liya aur apne paas sofa par bithaya.

lines.original: Dhika: feeling very shy... she said quietly... if you like..... I can help you practice....
lines.local: Dhika bahut sharmaate hue dheere se boli: Agar tum chaaho... toh practice mein main tumhari madad kar sakti hoon...

lines.original: Chotu: Not understand..... practice what didi....
lines.local: Chotu ko samajh nahi aaya: Kis cheez ki practice, didi?
Dhika blush karte hue: Kissing ki practice.

lines.original: Chotu: feeling stunned by her offer....he took a moment before asking... "didi... really ?"
lines.local: Chotu uske offer se hairaan: Didi... sach?

lines.original: Dhika: hmmm if you like....she blushed
lines.local: Dhika: Hmmm, agar tum chaaho. Woh sharmaayi.

lines.original: Chotu: quietly.... you would do that for me....?
lines.local: Chotu dheere se: Aap mere liye aisa karogi?

lines.original: As and when he ended that question..... the next second... Dhika threw her face into him....
lines.local: Uska sawaal poora hote hi agle second Dhika uske chehre ki taraf jhuki.

lines.original: Closing her eyes... she gave a thick long kiss on his lips......
lines.local: Aankhein band karke usne Chotu ke honton par ek gahra aur lamba kiss diya.
Chotu ki aankhein badi ho gayin.

lines.original: Her lips felt so soft on his.... with her pressing her lips hard on him... he felt his doubt and question melt........ and slowly closing his eyes, he too pressed back at her....
lines.local: Dhika ke naram hont apne honton par mehsoos karte hue uska sawaal aur doubt gayab ho gaya; dheere se aankhein band karke usne bhi kiss return kiya.

lines.original: Dhika: leaving him.... hehe... how was it....
lines.local: Dhika kiss chhodkar: Hehe, kaisa tha?

lines.original: Chotu: feeling more shy than her....it was...it was.....
lines.local: Chotu usse bhi zyada sharma gaya: Woh... woh...

lines.original: Without finishing his sentence.... this time... he leapt forward and holding her chin, he looked into her rosy lips and kissed her.... It was not as good as when she kissed him but Dhika, feeling glad that he is taking initiative... put her hands on his chin and kissed him back....
lines.local: Vaakya poora kiye bina is baar Chotu khud aage badha, Dhika ki thodi pakadkar uske honton ko dekha aur kiss kiya. Kiss Dhika ke pehle kiss jitna polished nahi tha, lekin Chotu ki initiative se khush hokar Dhika ne uski thodi pakdi aur kiss return kiya.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe.. she giggled leaving him.
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe... woh alag hote hue hansi.

lines.original: Chotu: feeling awkward and smiling shy... he scratched his head.....
lines.local: Chotu awkward smile aur sharm mein apna sir khujaane laga.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... don't worry. I will help you master it... she said blushing and giggling.
lines.local: Dhika sharmaakar hansti hui: Don't worry. Master banne mein tumhari madad karungi.

lines.original: .....She stood up and bid him goodbye for the day.
lines.local: Woh khadi hui aur aaj ke liye Chotu ko bye kaha.
